copy.curiosityHook: When the imagined roar of circus applause dissolves into the sound of falling rain, what remains for a forgotten unicycle waiting out his fate?
copy.description: Stuck in the clearance corner of Eben's Bikes, a lonely unicycle named Red passes the quiet hours by imagining a grand circus act alongside a clown owner, hoping to escape his forgotten corner.
copy.vibeSummary: Poignant, quiet, and reflective. An easy four-minute watch with moderate emotional resonance, suitable for solitary or family viewing.
copy.whyWatch: Directed by John Lasseter, this dialogue-free four-minute animated short balances whimsical circus spectacle with a surprisingly poignant meditation on longing and isolation.
